d:
Everyone told us we were crazy... So we spent 7 days in Iraq to see it for ourselves, and it was nothing like we expected!
We wandered the buzzing streets of Baghdad, witnessed the holy shrines in Karbala, and stood among the ancient ruins of Babylon. Everywhere we went, we were met with tea, smiles, and some of the warmest hospitality on earth.
I hope this video changes your perception of Iraq. Let me know in the comments down below if you have any questions about what it's like to travel there, and I'll do my best to respond!
